history.title: History
history.description: Every cleanup, restore, and deletion, newest first. It never leaves your computer.
history.label: History entries
history.nothingFreed: Nothing freed yet. Test runs don't count.
history.detailsKept: File-by-file details are kept for {{days, number}} days. After that, each entry keeps its totals.
history.unreadable_one: {{count, number}} line of the history couldn't be read. It's left as it is.
history.unreadable_other: {{count, number}} lines of the history couldn't be read. They're left as they are.
history.empty: Nothing yet. Cleanups, restores, and deletions show up here.
history.interruptedHint: The app stopped before this finished; these numbers come from the files it recorded.
history.noDetails: File-by-file details for this entry are gone; they're kept for {{days, number}} days.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.description: Files a cleanup moved aside instead of deleting. Restore them while they're here; they're deleted for good when their time is up.
quarantine.label: Files in quarantine
quarantine.testMode: Test mode: nothing will be restored or deleted. You'll see what would happen.
quarantine.empty: Nothing is in quarantine. When a cleanup moves medium- or review-risk files here, you can restore them for 7 or 30 days.
quarantine.nextExpiry_one: {{count, number}} file ({{size}}) will be deleted for good on {{date}}.
quarantine.nextExpiry_other: {{count, number}} files ({{size}}) will be deleted for good on {{date}}.
quarantine.spaceNote: Their space is freed when they're deleted. Empty the quarantine to free it now.
quarantine.expired_one: On {{date}}, {{count, number}} file was deleted for good because its time in quarantine was up ({{size}} freed).
quarantine.expired_other: On {{date}}, {{count, number}} files were deleted for good because their time in quarantine was up ({{size}} freed).
quarantine.expiredTest_one: Test mode: {{count, number}} expired file would have been deleted when the app started.
quarantine.expiredTest_other: Test mode: {{count, number}} expired files would have been deleted when the app started.
quarantine.unreadable_one: Couldn't read {{count, number}} quarantine folder, so it's left alone: {{folders}}
quarantine.unreadable_other: Couldn't read {{count, number}} quarantine folders, so they're left alone: {{folders}}
quarantine.restored_one: Restored {{count, number}} file to where it came from.
quarantine.restored_other: Restored {{count, number}} files to where they came from.
quarantine.wouldRestore_one: Test mode: {{count, number}} file would be restored.
quarantine.wouldRestore_other: Test mode: {{count, number}} files would be restored.
quarantine.deleted_one: Deleted {{count, number}} file for good, freeing {{size}}.
quarantine.deleted_other: Deleted {{count, number}} files for good, freeing {{size}}.
quarantine.wouldDelete_one: Test mode: {{count, number}} file would be deleted for good, freeing {{size}}.
quarantine.wouldDelete_other: Test mode: {{count, number}} files would be deleted for good, freeing {{size}}.
quarantine.conflictTitle_one: {{count, number}} file has something in its place
quarantine.conflictTitle_other: {{count, number}} files have something in their place
quarantine.conflictBody: Something is at the original location again. What should happen?
quarantine.replaceHint: The file that's there now goes to quarantine for 30 days, so nothing is lost.
quarantine.keepBothHint: The restored file gets "(restored)" added to its name.
quarantine.skipHint: Those files stay in quarantine. The others are restored.
quarantine.deleteBody: These files are deleted permanently and can't be restored afterward.
quarantine.understand_one: I understand that {{count, number}} file will be permanently deleted.
quarantine.understand_other: I understand that {{count, number}} files will be permanently deleted.

protected.title: Protected
protected.description: Protected items never show up in results and are never cleaned, even when a rule would find them.
protected.empty: Nothing is protected yet. Choose "Protect" in the details of any result, or add a pattern above.
protected.patternHint: A name like *.psd matches anywhere. A path like D:\Projects\** matches everything inside it.
protected.imported_one: Added {{count, number}} item from the file.
protected.imported_other: Added {{count, number}} items from the file.
protected.importedNone: Everything in that file was already protected.
protected.exported: Saved a copy of your Protected list.
protected.comesBack: Items you stop protecting show up again on the next scan.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
settings.damagedHint: Scanning and cleaning are paused until this is fixed, so nothing runs with settings you didn't choose. Restore the defaults, or fix the file and come back.
settings.restoreHint: Puts every setting back the way it was when you installed OpenJanitor.

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.minAgeHint: Files changed more recently than this are never offered for cleaning. Rules that already wait longer, like old logs and shader caches (30 days), keep their own wait.
cleaning.applies: Takes effect on the next scan.

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.alwaysHint: Low-risk files go to quarantine too, instead of being deleted right away, so you can restore them.
quarantine.alwaysWarning: Cleanups won't free space right away: it's freed when the files expire or when you empty the quarantine. Some caches take several gigabytes.
quarantine.mediumAlso: Low-risk files are kept this long too.
quarantine.applies: Takes effect on the next cleanup. Files already in quarantine keep their dates.

scan.title: Simple clean
scan.description: Finds temporary files and caches that Windows and your apps recreate when they need them.
scan.idle: Scanning only reads your drive. Nothing is deleted or moved.
scan.notInApp: Scanning works in the desktop app. Start it with "npm run dev" from the project folder.
scan.summary_one: can be freed from {{count, number}} file
scan.summary_other: can be freed from {{count, number}} files
scan.nothingDeleted: Nothing is deleted until you review a cleanup and confirm it.
scan.nothingFound: Nothing to clean right now. Everything this scan looks for is already tidy.

results.label: Scan results
results.recommendedHint: Recommended means low-risk items, minus big caches that just grow back. Nothing is selected until you choose.
results.protectedNotice: Protected "{{name}}". It won't show up in results or be cleaned. Manage it on the Protected screen.
results.protectedRules: Not scanned, because you protected them: {{rules}}
results.notChecked: Couldn't fully check without administrator rights: {{rules}}. Checking with admin rights arrives in a later version.

clean.title: Review this cleanup
clean.description: Here's what happens to the files you selected.
clean.testMode: Test mode: nothing will be deleted or moved. You'll see what a real cleanup would do.
clean.staleBody: Files may have changed since then. Scan again for an up-to-date list.
clean.deleteHint: Low-risk files that Windows and your apps recreate when they need them.
clean.quarantineTitle_one: Moved to quarantine for {{count, number}} day
clean.quarantineTitle_other: Moved to quarantine for {{count, number}} days
clean.quarantineHint: You can restore them until {{date}}. Their space is freed after that.
clean.adminHint: They need administrator rights. Cleaning them arrives in a later version.
clean.binHint: Everything in it is deleted, however recently it was deleted. Open the Recycle Bin first if you might want something back.
clean.binKeptHint: “Always use the quarantine” is on, and the Recycle Bin can’t be moved to quarantine. Empty it in File Explorer, or turn that setting off.
clean.nothingToClean: Nothing you selected can be cleaned yet.
clean.appsOpenTitle_one: Close this app to clean its cache
clean.appsOpenTitle_other: Close these apps to clean their caches
clean.appsOpenBody: While an app is open, its cache is left out. Some apps keep running in the notification area after you close their window.
clean.appsLeftOut: Left out because they were open: {{apps}}.
clean.understand_one: I understand that {{count, number}} file will be permanently deleted.
clean.understand_other: I understand that {{count, number}} files will be permanently deleted.
clean.understandBin_one: I understand that the {{count, number}} item in the Recycle Bin will be permanently deleted.
clean.understandBin_other: I understand that the {{count, number}} items in the Recycle Bin will be permanently deleted.
clean.understandBoth: I understand that {{files}} and the {{items}} in the Recycle Bin will be permanently deleted.
clean.stopHint: Stopping finishes the file it's on, so nothing is left half done.
clean.testDoneNote: Test mode: nothing was deleted or moved. These numbers show what a real cleanup would do.
clean.wouldDeleteFiles_one: {{count, number}} file would be deleted permanently
clean.wouldDeleteFiles_other: {{count, number}} files would be deleted permanently
clean.quarantined_one: {{count, number}} file in quarantine ({{size}}), restorable until {{date}}
clean.quarantined_other: {{count, number}} files in quarantine ({{size}}), restorable until {{date}}
clean.quarantineSpace: Space in quarantine is freed when the files are deleted for good.
clean.binEmptied_one: Emptied the Recycle Bin on drive {{drive}} ({{count, number}} item, {{size}}).
clean.binEmptied_other: Emptied the Recycle Bin on drive {{drive}} ({{count, number}} items, {{size}}).
clean.binWouldEmpty_one: The Recycle Bin on drive {{drive}} would be emptied ({{count, number}} item, {{size}}).
clean.binWouldEmpty_other: The Recycle Bin on drive {{drive}} would be emptied ({{count, number}} items, {{size}}).
clean.binSkipped: Left the Recycle Bin on drive {{drive}} alone ({{reason}}). Scan again to empty it.
clean.binKeptLine: Left the Recycle Bin on drive {{drive}} out, because “Always use the quarantine” is on.
clean.foldersRemoved_one: Removed {{count, number}} folder the cleanup left empty.
clean.foldersRemoved_other: Removed {{count, number}} folders the cleanup left empty.
clean.notStarted_one: {{count, number}} file wasn't touched, because you stopped the cleanup.
clean.notStarted_other: {{count, number}} files weren't touched, because you stopped the cleanup.
clean.adminLeftOut_one: {{count, number}} file that needs administrator rights was left out.
clean.adminLeftOut_other: {{count, number}} files that need administrator rights were left out.
clean.inUseHint: Close the programs using them, then scan and clean again.
clean.historyError: The history couldn't be written in full: {{error}}
clean.resultsGone: The old results are cleared. Scan again to see what's left.

reason.other_drive: On another drive than the quarantine
reason.conflict: Something else is in the way
reason.app_running: Its app was opened during the cleanup

details.label: Details
details.empty: Select an item to see what it is and why it was found.
details.adminNote: Cleaning this needs administrator rights. You'll be asked once per cleanup.
details.partlyRead: Some of its folders can only be read with administrator rights, so there may be more to clean.
details.notRecommended: "Select recommended" leaves this out. Select it yourself if you want to clean it.
details.protectHint: Never show or clean this again. You can undo it on the Protected screen.
